digest.component_or_area: CLI confirmation emit and verb mutation inventory
propositions: Reduce-path structural tests must spy the shared confirmation seam to detect regressions where verbs bypass emit_text and print directly
Mutation verb inventory must be enumerable, durable, and drift-gated: test must fail when a verb is added without no-op classification
Old-to-new confirmation-line mapping must be recorded as golden data to preserve pre-merger behavior documentation
Confirmation formatters must work with no store present, verified by formatting in an empty temp directory with REBAR_ROOT unset
Generated docs/cli-reference.md must maintain curated data tables (verb inventory and confirmation mapping) via render phase in the generator script
Seam-spy test must validate exactly one line routed per verb dispatch and no output printed outside the shared emit interface
